purpose: Teach: 誓っ/ぎっしり/ノルマ/砂浜/ダメージ/贈っ/学芸/あ〜

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、お店を続けるって誓ってるの
lines.en: Sho, we've promised to keep the store going, haven't we?
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. Speaking as though to herself as much as to him. Warm but slightly distant, the way someone sounds when they're carrying something quietly. Steady breath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくのリュック、お菓子がぎっしりだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my backpack is packed full of candy!
lines.style: Bright, bouncing energy. Rapid delivery. Pride bubbling just under the surface. The specific delight of a child announcing something he's been holding onto. Open, clear voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さん、お仕事のノルマで忙しいのよ
lines.en: Sho, your mom's been so busy with work quotas lately.
lines.style: Soft explanation, not complaint. Gentle acknowledgment. Speaking as someone who understands what's taking Mom away. Slight protective note underneath — she's explaining on Mom's behalf.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと砂浜に行きたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to go to the beach with Dad.
lines.style: Quiet, almost wistful. A small wish voiced carefully, as though testing whether it's okay to want this. Gentle but genuine longing. Not demanding — hopeful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達の心にダメージを与えないでね
lines.en: Sho, be careful not to hurt your friends' feelings, okay?
lines.style: Warm, protective. A gentle reminder wrapped in care, not scolding. The tone of someone who knows he's good-hearted and is just guiding him. Slight pause before the 'okay' — checking in with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママにお花を贈ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I gave Mom some flowers!
lines.style: Eager to share good news. Bright, proud announcement. Quick tempo. The specific joy of a child who's done something thoughtful and wants confirmation that it was right. Open, unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、学芸会、お父さんもいらっしゃるわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going to be at your school play.
lines.style: Reassuring, warm. A small piece of good news delivered gently. Matter-of-fact but with tenderness underneath. The tone of someone making sure he knows he's going to be seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、あ〜、お腹空いちゃった
lines.style: A shift into immediate, physical complaint. Lighter tone. Quick, slightly exasperated delivery — the naturalness of a child's sudden hunger announcement. Not whining, just honest.
